description: angelone-documents says an Aadhaar-linked mobile number is mandatory; guidelines-revised (para 9.3, Farmer Attributes Optional) and faq-revised (Q20 iv, 'not mandatory') treat the mobile number as optional
guidelines-revised (paras 6.1 and 10.2) say the Aadhaar exemption for Assam, Meghalaya and J&K runs till 31.3.2021; faq-revised (Q20, Q27, Q35) says 31 March 2020

angelone-eligibility says saturation drives now allow new families, including through 'recent updates'; guidelines-revised (para 5.2) and faq-revised (Q12) say no changes after the 01.02.2019 cut-off for 5 years, except succession on death
eKYC is described in both angelone pages and Unique Farmer ID in angelone-documents; guidelines-revised, faq-revised and myscheme mention only Aadhaar seeding or authentication
faq-revised and myscheme carry no publication or update date; faq-revised only refers to 2020 deadlines and uses the word 'Recently'
angelone-eligibility has '2025' in its title but states 'Updated on 12th Mar, 2026', so its date is inconsistent
